title: Shared Product Base Layout Shell
description: Extract duplicated navbar/canvas/footer + floating left/right side-panel shell into ProductShell in @semio-tech/framework-platform-renderer-react; PlatformView and PlaygroundView become thin wrappers.
summary: Added ProductShell (navbar, floating left/right SidePanel, ShellModeCanvas window canvas, footer, toolbar overlay, optional search/find hotkeys). PlatformView delegates layout to ProductShell. PlaygroundView imports ProductShell and shared helpers (findDefaultActiveWindowKindId, declareToolsToViewTools, UIToolbar); removed duplicated ShellModeCanvas, layout conversion, and PlaygroundToolbar. Exported convertFrameworkLayoutToShellLayout, findDefaultActiveWindowKindId, ShellModeCanvas. Platform renderer 7 tests pass; playground renderer 11 tests pass.
